newsitem.title: UK: Amstrad shares down on Pace outlook.
newsitem.headline: Amstrad shares down on Pace outlook.

text.p: Shares in consumer electronics group Amstrad Plc fell on Tuesday after a cautious trading statement from Pace Micro Technology Plc on the outlook for sales of satellite and cable television equipment, dealers said.
Amstrad shares were down 7-1/2p to 152-1/2 by 0847 GMT.
"They've been hit by disappointment about Pace," one market-maker said.

Announcing its half-year results, Pace said it expected to achieve its original budget for this year but did not anticipate any "over performance" from new contracts. It said sterling's strength had put pressure on prices and margins.
Pace shares fell more than 20 percent, sliding 48p to 178-1/2.
